subject: english-literature
title: Love, Identity, Conflict
welcome_lead: Three of the biggest themes in all of literature.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on love, identity and conflict themes.
final_note: You can now spot love, identity and conflict in any text.

walkthroughs.body_html: Love shows up as romance, family, friendship or sacrifice. Identify which kind a text explores.
The theme of identity asks who a character really is — under names, masks and others' expectations.
Conflict can be inside (self-doubt) or outside (rival, war, society). It often interlocks with power and identity.

mcqs.q: Who a character truly is = the theme.

numericals.q: How many themes here (love, identity, conflict, belonging, power, loss)?

free_texts.q: Being part of a group is the theme of ____.
